trips.route_note: Take the Whoosh high-speed train from Halim station to Padalarang, then a feeder train or shuttle to Bandung station; the rail leg is about 45 minutes plus the connection.
trips.why: The bus covers the route in about 1h 57m, quicker than the 4h 30m rail option with its connection, and Bandung's sights are reachable from the drop-off.
know: Book bus seats ahead for weekend travel
Cooler highland climate, so bring a light layer
Weekdays are less crowded than weekends

bus.via: Jakarta Halim Perdana Kusuma Airport to Botani Square

trips.route_note: Take a KRL Commuter Line train from Jakarta Kota or Manggarai toward Bogor; it runs direct to Bogor station in about 1.5 hours, then walk or take a local angkot to the Botanical Gardens.
trips.why: The KRL Commuter Line runs direct to Bogor station in about 1h 10m, faster than the 2h 5m bus and dropping you near the Botanical Gardens.
know: Botanical Gardens are best visited on a weekday morning to avoid crowds
Trains can be very crowded at peak commute hours
Afternoon rain is common in the wet season, so go early

trips.route_note: Commuter trains and TransJakarta/KRL connections run from central Jakarta to Tangerang station in under an hour; the old town is a short walk or ojek ride away.
trips.tour_query: Tangerang old town half day from Jakarta
trips.why: Commuter trains reach Tangerang station in about 1h 23m and the old town is a short walk or ojek ride away.
know: The old town is small and quick to see
Trains are frequent but crowded at rush hour

trips.route_note: KRL Commuter Line trains from Jakarta Kota or Manggarai reach Bekasi station directly in about 40 minutes; local transport covers the last stretch to the sights.
trips.why: KRL trains reach Bekasi station directly in about 42m, far faster than the 1h 14m bus.
know: Few classic sights, so treat it as a low-key outing
Avoid peak commute hours when trains are packed
